investment_strategy: Barbell the AI cycle: overweight resilient, cash-generative platform leaders with positive analyst conviction (Microsoft, Alphabet) and add a smaller, higher-beta semiconductor enabler (Micron) to capture AI-driven memory and data center tailwinds. Given NASDAQ’s -3.4% 30-day pullback, VIX ~19.6, and a 4.23% 10Y yield pressuring multiples, size risk conservatively, emphasize quality balance sheets and earnings beats, and keep the cyclical exposure capped. Implement as a single allocation now with quarterly rebalancing, trimming the cyclical leg if VIX > 25 or if AI-capex payback/regulatory headlines spike volatility. Monitor U.S.–China export policy, antitrust developments, and enterprise AI adoption KPIs.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility and balance sheet strength, strong fundamental growth and EPS beat cadence, positive analyst consensus, and favorable momentum; excluded names with negative momentum, weaker consensus, or outsized policy/operational risk relative to reward.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Long-term constructive on AI-driven technology and semiconductor demand; near-term cautious with VIX ~19.6 and 10Y at 4.23% compressing multiples. Expect episodic volatility from AI capex payback debates, regulatory headlines, and U.S.–China tech policy; a diversified barbell across platforms and enablers remains appropriate.
